sentences.text:
This is first application filed under Section 483 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (for short 'BNSS') by the applicant for grant of regular bail relating to Crime No.112/2025 registered at Police Station Salamatpur, District Raisen (M.P.), for the offence punishable under Sections 363,
366 and 376(2)(n) of IPC and sections 5L read with section 6 of POCSO Act.
The applicant is in custody since 16.10.2025.
2. Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the case.
It is also submitted that the prosecutrix might be above the age of 18 years.
She left her parental house of her own volition.
It is also submitted that the prosecutrix and her mother have not supported the case of the prosecution during trial, as revealed from their statements, copies of which are placed on record.

Thus, it is prayed that applicant may be released on bail.
NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2026:MPHC-JBP:9259 2 MCRC-59595-2025 3.
On the other hand, the counsel for the respondent/State has opposed the bail application.
4. Considering overall facts and circumstances of the case but without commenting anything on the merits of the case, application is allowed.

5. It is directed that the present applicant namely Ravi Sehriya shall be enlarged on bail upon his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with separate surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial court concerned for his appearance before Ravi Sehriya vs The State Of Madhya Prsdesh on 2 February, 2026

sentences.text: the said Court on all such dates as may be fixed in this regard during pendency of the trial.

It is further directed that the applicant shall comply with the provisions of Section 480 (3) of BNSS.
6.
Accordingly, this M.Cr.C. stands allowed and disposed of.
